paper_title: Direct Search for Dark Matter Axions Excluding ALP Cogenesis in the 63-67 micro-eV Range, with The ORGAN Experiment
notes: ORGAN Phase 1a microwave cavity haloscope sets 95% CL limit g_agamma >= 3e-12 GeV^-1 over 63.2-67.1 ueV (15.28-16.23 GHz). Only the headline limit value and mass range are available numerically in text; the exclusion curve (Fig. 4) varies across the band but specific point values are not tabulated. Local DM density assumed 0.45 GeV/cm^3. | Vision: The actual achieved exclusion is shown by the two narrow green vertical bands (1a near 14.5 GHz reaching down to ~3e-12, and 1b near 26.5 GHz reaching down to ~1.2e-12). Red dashed lines (2a-2g) are projected/future limits, not achieved. The wide colored regions are CAST and ALP Cogenesis bounds. Only the green-band achieved limits are reported here. X-axis is frequency 14-53 GHz converted to mass via m=4.136e-15*f. | Calibration: Benchmark KSVZ consistent (ratio=1.08) | Spot-check calibration: verify/stage2 ratio=0.2x
